lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Protest in Whitehorse, alongside others nationwide, stands against Bill C-39, CBC News reports.
Nvidia sell-off continues after CEO Jensen Huang steps down, The Associated Press reports.
Widespread outage hits Outlook, other Microsoft apps, The Associated Press reports.
Chris Van Hollen to challenge Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader, The Guardian reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
